_about: 1.7.10 BiomeGenBase field names used by OreSpawn's 348 addSpawn calls -> 1.21.1 biome ids or biome tags ("#ns:path"). Targets verified against net/minecraft/world/level/biome/Biomes.java and net/minecraft/tags/BiomeTags.java IS_NETHER (1.21.1). Only direct successors are mapped: in 1.7.10 the mutated variants (sunflower plains, flower forest, ...) copied their spawn lists from the parent at class-load time, before any mod called addSpawn, so they never carried OreSpawn mobs. Biomes merged away in 1.18 map to the biome that absorbed them. DECISIONS R26 (R22 category rule): biomes that 1.21.1 split off a 1.7.10 biome count as that biome - hell is the whole Nether (#minecraft:is_nether), ocean adds lukewarm/warm/cold, deepOcean adds deep_lukewarm/deep_cold, swampland adds mangrove_swamp, jungle/jungleHills add bamboo_jungle. frozen_ocean/deep_frozen_ocean stay out: 1.7.10 already had them as separate biomes without OreSpawn spawns.

legacy_names._about: OreSpawnWorld compared BiomeGenBase.biomeName with equals (OreSpawnWorld.java:311, 968, 1004, 1131, 1293 and the structure passes). Each tag data/orespawn/tags/worldgen/biome/legacy_name/<tag>.json is the union of the map targets of the listed 1.7.10 biome fields whose biomeName the original tested; tools/gen_spawns.py writes them. Only the exact names count: "Extreme Hills" is not "Extreme Hills Edge", "Taiga" is not "TaigaHills", "Ocean" is not "Deep Ocean".
